description: Preview then explicitly confirm your own capper or club links. Supply draft {profileId,target: profile or club,expectedRevision,links:[{platform,handle?,url?}]}. Array order is display order; omit a platform to remove it. Use [] for no links, or null for club links to inherit the capper profile. One per platform: x, instagram, tiktok, youtube, discord, facebook. For Discord/Facebook provide url and optional display handle. Set needs the returned preview draft (including any resolved Discord name), exact previewBinding, SET_PROFILE_LINKS confirmation and a stable commandKey. verified is server-owned.
name: set_profile_links
title: Set your profile links
